GRADE 9 INDIGENOUS LANGUAGES — TERM 3 EXAM

Grade: Grade 9
Subject: INDIGENOUS LANGUAGES
Time: 64 minutes

INSTRUCTIONS
1. Answer all questions.
2. Use neat handwriting.
2. For multiple choice, write the correct letter only.
3. For short answers, write clearly in the spaces provided.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A: Multiple Choice

1. About Reading 7.2.1 Reading for Information in a conversation with a classmate, which statement is correct?
   A. describe visuals accompanying texts for comprehension,
   B. Learners should ignore Reading 7.2.1 Reading for Information completely.
   C. Reading 7.2.1 Reading for Information is only useful outside Kenya.
   D. There is no need to practise Reading 7.2.1 Reading for Information.

2. About Reading 7.2.1 Reading for Information when reading a story about Kenya, which statement is correct?
   A. make connections between visuals and accompanying texts for information,
   B. Learners should ignore Reading 7.2.1 Reading for Information completely.
   C. Reading 7.2.1 Reading for Information is only useful outside Kenya.
   D. There is no need to practise Reading 7.2.1 Reading for Information.

3. About Reading 7.2.1 Reading for Information while writing in your exercise book, which statement is correct?
   A. create visuals from written texts for effective communication,
   B. Learners should ignore Reading 7.2.1 Reading for Information completely.
   C. Reading 7.2.1 Reading for Information is only useful outside Kenya.
   D. There is no need to practise Reading 7.2.1 Reading for Information.

5. About Writing 7.3.1 Assessment of Writing – Narrative Composition in a conversation with a classmate, which statement is correct?
   A. recognise the features of a well- written composition for information,
   B. Learners should ignore Writing 7.3.1 Assessment of Writing – Narrative Composition completely.
   C. Writing 7.3.1 Assessment of Writing – Narrative Composition is only useful outside Kenya.
   D. There is no need to practise Writing 7.3.1 Assessment of Writing – Narrative Composition.

6. About Writing 7.3.1 Assessment of Writing – Narrative Composition when reading a story about Kenya, which statement is correct?
   A. assess written texts for relevance, punctuation, and neatness,
   B. Learners should ignore Writing 7.3.1 Assessment of Writing – Narrative Composition completely.
   C. Writing 7.3.1 Assessment of Writing – Narrative Composition is only useful outside Kenya.
   D. There is no need to practise Writing 7.3.1 Assessment of Writing – Narrative Composition.

7. About Writing 7.3.1 Assessment of Writing – Narrative Composition while writing in your exercise book, which statement is correct?
   A. recognise the features of a well- written composition for information,
   B. Learners should ignore Writing 7.3.1 Assessment of Writing – Narrative Composition completely.
   C. Writing 7.3.1 Assessment of Writing – Narrative Composition is only useful outside Kenya.
   D. There is no need to practise Writing 7.3.1 Assessment of Writing – Narrative Composition.

9. About Listening and Speaking 8.1.1 Storytelling - Legends in a conversation with a classmate, which statement is correct?
   A. Explain the meaning of Listening and Speaking 8.1.1 Storytelling - Legends using a Kenyan example.
   B. Learners should ignore Listening and Speaking 8.1.1 Storytelling - Legends completely.
   C. Listening and Speaking 8.1.1 Storytelling - Legends is only useful outside Kenya.
   D. There is no need to practise Listening and Speaking 8.1.1 Storytelling - Legends.

10. About Listening and Speaking 8.1.1 Storytelling - Legends when reading a story about Kenya, which statement is correct?
   A. Practise Listening and Speaking 8.1.1 Storytelling - Legends at school and at home.
   B. Learners should ignore Listening and Speaking 8.1.1 Storytelling - Legends completely.
   C. Listening and Speaking 8.1.1 Storytelling - Legends is only useful outside Kenya.
   D. There is no need to practise Listening and Speaking 8.1.1 Storytelling - Legends.

11. About Listening and Speaking 8.1.1 Storytelling - Legends while writing in your exercise book, which statement is correct?
   A. Listening and Speaking 8.1.1 Storytelling - Legends helps learners in daily life in Kenya.
   B. Learners should ignore Listening and Speaking 8.1.1 Storytelling - Legends completely.
   C. Listening and Speaking 8.1.1 Storytelling - Legends is only useful outside Kenya.
   D. There is no need to practise Listening and Speaking 8.1.1 Storytelling - Legends.

13. About Reading 8.2.1 Intensive Reading – Legends in a conversation with a classmate, which statement is correct?
   A. outline the characteristics of legends for information,
   B. Learners should ignore Reading 8.2.1 Intensive Reading – Legends completely.
   C. Reading 8.2.1 Intensive Reading – Legends is only useful outside Kenya.
   D. There is no need to practise Reading 8.2.1 Intensive Reading – Legends.

14. About Reading 8.2.1 Intensive Reading – Legends when reading a story about Kenya, which statement is correct?
   A. respond to questions from legends for comprehension,
   B. Learners should ignore Reading 8.2.1 Intensive Reading – Legends completely.
   C. Reading 8.2.1 Intensive Reading – Legends is only useful outside Kenya.
   D. There is no need to practise Reading 8.2.1 Intensive Reading – Legends.

15. About Reading 8.2.1 Intensive Reading – Legends while writing in your exercise book, which statement is correct?
   A. outline the characteristics of legends for information,
   B. Learners should ignore Reading 8.2.1 Intensive Reading – Legends completely.
   C. Reading 8.2.1 Intensive Reading – Legends is only useful outside Kenya.
   D. There is no need to practise Reading 8.2.1 Intensive Reading – Legends.

17. About Writing 8.3.1 Creative writing – short story in a conversation with a classmate, which statement is correct?
   A. explain the features of a short story for information,
   B. Learners should ignore Writing 8.3.1 Creative writing – short story completely.
   C. Writing 8.3.1 Creative writing – short story is only useful outside Kenya.
   D. There is no need to practise Writing 8.3.1 Creative writing – short story.

18. About Writing 8.3.1 Creative writing – short story when reading a story about Kenya, which statement is correct?
   A. write a short story featuring a hero or heroine for creative expression,
   B. Learners should ignore Writing 8.3.1 Creative writing – short story completely.
   C. Writing 8.3.1 Creative writing – short story is only useful outside Kenya.
   D. There is no need to practise Writing 8.3.1 Creative writing – short story.

19. About Writing 8.3.1 Creative writing – short story while writing in your exercise book, which statement is correct?
   A. explain the features of a short story for information,
   B. Learners should ignore Writing 8.3.1 Creative writing – short story completely.
   C. Writing 8.3.1 Creative writing – short story is only useful outside Kenya.
   D. There is no need to practise Writing 8.3.1 Creative writing – short story.

21. About Listening and Speaking 9.1.1 Presentation Skills in a conversation with a classmate, which statement is correct?
   A. Explain the meaning of Listening and Speaking 9.1.1 Presentation Skills using a Kenyan example.
   B. Learners should ignore Listening and Speaking 9.1.1 Presentation Skills completely.
   C. Listening and Speaking 9.1.1 Presentation Skills is only useful outside Kenya.
   D. There is no need to practise Listening and Speaking 9.1.1 Presentation Skills.

22. About Listening and Speaking 9.1.1 Presentation Skills when reading a story about Kenya, which statement is correct?
   A. Practise Listening and Speaking 9.1.1 Presentation Skills at school and at home.
   B. Learners should ignore Listening and Speaking 9.1.1 Presentation Skills completely.
   C. Listening and Speaking 9.1.1 Presentation Skills is only useful outside Kenya.
   D. There is no need to practise Listening and Speaking 9.1.1 Presentation Skills.

23. About Listening and Speaking 9.1.1 Presentation Skills while writing in your exercise book, which statement is correct?
   A. Listening and Speaking 9.1.1 Presentation Skills helps learners in daily life in Kenya.
   B. Learners should ignore Listening and Speaking 9.1.1 Presentation Skills completely.
   C. Listening and Speaking 9.1.1 Presentation Skills is only useful outside Kenya.
   D. There is no need to practise Listening and Speaking 9.1.1 Presentation Skills.

25. About Reading 9.2.1 Extensive reading – Grade- appropriate texts in a conversation with a classmate, which statement is correct?
   A. outline the main ideas from texts for comprehension,
   B. Learners should ignore Reading 9.2.1 Extensive reading – Grade- appropriate texts completely.
   C. Reading 9.2.1 Extensive reading – Grade- appropriate texts is only useful outside Kenya.
   D. There is no need to practise Reading 9.2.1 Extensive reading – Grade- appropriate texts.

26. About Reading 9.2.1 Extensive reading – Grade- appropriate texts when reading a story about Kenya, which statement is correct?
   A. infer the meaning of vocabulary from the text for language acquisition,
   B. Learners should ignore Reading 9.2.1 Extensive reading – Grade- appropriate texts completely.
   C. Reading 9.2.1 Extensive reading – Grade- appropriate texts is only useful outside Kenya.
   D. There is no need to practise Reading 9.2.1 Extensive reading – Grade- appropriate texts.

27. About Reading 9.2.1 Extensive reading – Grade- appropriate texts while writing in your exercise book, which statement is correct?
   A. outline the main ideas from texts for comprehension,
   B. Learners should ignore Reading 9.2.1 Extensive reading – Grade- appropriate texts completely.
   C. Reading 9.2.1 Extensive reading – Grade- appropriate texts is only useful outside Kenya.
   D. There is no need to practise Reading 9.2.1 Extensive reading – Grade- appropriate texts.

29. About Writing 9.3.1 Functional Writing – Letters of Application in a conversation with a classmate, which statement is correct?
   A. recognise the components of a letter of application for information.
   B. Learners should ignore Writing 9.3.1 Functional Writing – Letters of Application completely.
   C. Writing 9.3.1 Functional Writing – Letters of Application is only useful outside Kenya.
   D. There is no need to practise Writing 9.3.1 Functional Writing – Letters of Application.

30. About Writing 9.3.1 Functional Writing – Letters of Application when reading a story about Kenya, which statement is correct?
   A. write a letter of application for a scholarship for effective communication,
   B. Learners should ignore Writing 9.3.1 Functional Writing – Letters of Application completely.
   C. Writing 9.3.1 Functional Writing – Letters of Application is only useful outside Kenya.
   D. There is no need to practise Writing 9.3.1 Functional Writing – Letters of Application.

31. About Writing 9.3.1 Functional Writing – Letters of Application while writing in your exercise book, which statement is correct?
   A. recognise the components of a letter of application for information.
   B. Learners should ignore Writing 9.3.1 Functional Writing – Letters of Application completely.
   C. Writing 9.3.1 Functional Writing – Letters of Application is only useful outside Kenya.
   D. There is no need to practise Writing 9.3.1 Functional Writing – Letters of Application.

SECTION B: Short Answers

4. Give two examples of how you can use Reading 7.2.1 Reading for Information in a conversation with a classmate.

8. Give two examples of how you can use Writing 7.3.1 Assessment of Writing – Narrative Composition in a conversation with a classmate.

12. Give two examples of how you can use Listening and Speaking 8.1.1 Storytelling - Legends in a conversation with a classmate.

16. Give two examples of how you can use Reading 8.2.1 Intensive Reading – Legends in a conversation with a classmate.
